Settings.Title: LaserW1tch's Token Flip 5e: File Picker Permissions
Settings.Heading: File picker permissions
Settings.Browse: Users need the Browse Files permission to choose an image that is already stored in this Foundry world.
Settings.Upload: Users need the Upload New File permission only if they should upload their own images. The GM can upload images for players instead.
Settings.ActorAccess: Users also need permission to update the character whose alternate art they are setting.
Settings.Tokenizer: When Tokenizer is active, selecting an image opens Tokenizer before it is saved. Players need Tokenizer's Trusted Player permission and upload access for Tokenizer's configured output folder.
